title: Columbus CoC Crash Data - aggregate summary by area
text:
Aggregate crash summary by area - Columbus CoC Crash Data (2021-2025).
- City of Columbus crash layer (all records) 2021: 12,033 crashes ((5) PDO/No Injury: 7,133, (3) Minor Injury Suspected: 2,914, (4) Injury Possible: 1,565, (2) Serious Injury Suspected: 340, (1) Fatal: 81). Of these: 25 pedestrian fatalities (field PedFatal); 4 bicyclist fatalities (field BikeFatal).
- City of Columbus crash layer (all records) 2022: 11,876 crashes ((5) PDO/No Injury: 7,546, (3) Minor Injury Suspected: 2,464, (4) Injury Possible: 1,508, (2) Serious Injury Suspected: 290, (1) Fatal: 68). Of these: 23 pedestrian fatalities (field PedFatal); 1 bicyclist fatalities (field BikeFatal).
- City of Columbus crash layer (all records) 2023: 12,947 crashes ((5) PDO/No Injury: 8,557, (3) Minor Injury Suspected: 2,525, (4) Injury Possible: 1,493, (2) Serious Injury Suspected: 304, (1) Fatal: 68). Of these: 19 pedestrian fatalities (field PedFatal); 3 bicyclist fatalities (field BikeFatal).
- City of Columbus crash layer (all records) 2024: 12,625 crashes ((5) PDO/No Injury: 8,321, (3) Minor Injury Suspected: 2,410, (4) Injury Possible: 1,582, (2) Serious Injury Suspected: 263, (1) Fatal: 49). Of these: 18 pedestrian fatalities (field PedFatal); 2 bicyclist fatalities (field BikeFatal).
- City of Columbus crash layer (all records) 2025: 12,703 crashes ((5) PDO/No Injury: 8,541, (3) Minor Injury Suspected: 2,321, (4) Injury Possible: 1,508, (2) Serious Injury Suspected: 282, (1) Fatal: 51). Of these: 19 pedestrian fatalities (field PedFatal); 2 bicyclist fatalities (field BikeFatal).
Computed on 2026-11-02 by counting records in the ArcGIS layer 'Columbus CoC Crash Data' grouped by CRASH_YR, SEVERITY_BY_TYPE_CD. Source: https://gis.columbus.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Schemas/PublicService/MapServer/23
caveats: Aggregate counts only, computed server-side; individual crash records are not loaded in this knowledge base.

The pedestrian figures count PedFatal, i.e. fatal only - not every crash involving a pedestrian. This layer publishes no plain pedestrian-involvement field, so the wider figure cannot be computed from it.
The bicycle figures count BikeFatal, i.e. fatal only - not every crash involving a bicyclist. This layer publishes no plain bicycle-involvement field, so the wider figure cannot be computed from it.
